players.product: Turnkey HPC data-center campuses leased to hyperscalers (Barber Lake, Black Pearl, Stingray - Texas) - ex-Bitcoin-mining, now 'Cipher Digital'

quarterly_data.signal: Cipher Digital's August 4, 2026 business-update presentation cites 10-15 year base lease terms, ~$11.4 Bn of contracted revenue and 700 MW of contracted gross HPC capacity; its current portfolio includes three data center campus leases with the world's leading hyperscalers.
quarterly_data.figure: 700 MW contracted gross HPC capacity; ~$11.4 Bn contracted revenue; 10-15 year base lease terms

quarterly_data.signal: Grid pipeline detail in the presentation: Reveille has ERCOT interconnection approved for 70 gross MW with substation development initiated and a 2027 Q3 target energization; Ulysses has interconnection approved for 200 gross MW with a 2027 Q4 target energization; both are in discussions for an HPC hosting lease. Colchis (1,000 MW), Mikeska (500 MW) and McLennan (500 MW) carry 2028 target energization, subject to the ERCOT batch process.
quarterly_data.figure: Reveille 70 gross MW (2027 Q3 target energization); Ulysses 200 gross MW (2027 Q4); Colchis 1,000 MW, Mikeska 500 MW, McLennan 500 MW (2028 target)
